title: Lean Muscle 12-Week (Sciatica Friendly)
author: Doug Nascimento
desc: Build lean muscle while protecting your sciatica

ex.note: Main upper press. ~1–2 reps in reserve early weeks.
Machine OK. Ribs down, no lower-back arch.
Spine-friendly. Belt loads hips not spine. Lean forward = more chest.
Chest pad removes all lower-back load.
Side delts. Light, controlled, short rest.
Anti-rotation core. No loaded twisting.
Main hinge. Squeeze glutes at top — do NOT hyperextend the low back.
Stop before the pelvis tucks at the bottom — that tuck is loaded lumbar flexion.
Hold a rail for balance. Big leg stimulus, tiny spinal load.
Replaces RDL — hamstrings with zero spinal load.
Hip stability, sciatica-neutral.
Slow. Low back stays neutral throughout.
May feel decompressive. Controlled negatives if needed.
Back priority. Squeeze shoulder blades.
Rear delts — keep traps & arms out of it.
Biceps.
McGill-approved for backs.
2nd weekly delt press.
2nd weekly side-delt hit — they recover fast.
Biceps.
Don't flare elbows or let the bar hit your head.
Biceps, stretch emphasis.
Long head of triceps.
Anti-lateral / anti-rotation core. Walk tall.
FIX: 2nd weekly quad hit, spine-neutral. Shores up the marginal quad volume. Drop first if recovery suffers.
